newsitem.title: UK: Premier Farnell down as profits drop.
newsitem.headline: Premier Farnell down as profits drop.

text.p: Shares in Premier Farnell Plc dropped in early trading on Monday after the company posted first-half profits at the low end of market forecasts.
The stock was down 14p at 666-1/2 by 0730 GMT, after on Friday rising to its highest level since June.
Pre-tax profits dropped to 56.1 million stg from 71.3 million stg a year before. Analysts' expectations had mostly been in a range between 57.5 million stg and 63.1 million stg.
In addition, the electronic components distributor said it did not expect to see a change in weak market conditions during the rest of the year.
